# 100 MB Benchmark

## Environment

- Command: `python -c "... summarize(Path('benchmark-100mb.log')) ..."`
- Input: `benchmark-100mb.log`, generated by `python scripts/gen_log.py benchmark-100mb.log --size-mb 100`
- Input size: 100 MiB.
- Runtime platform: Windows / Python 3.12.

## Result

| Metric | Value |
| --- | ---: |
| Summary runtime | 36.160 seconds |
| Errors counted | 944,662 |
| Malformed lines | 0 |
| Peak Python allocations | 578,088 bytes |

The runtime meets the under-60-second acceptance threshold. The parser reads the input line-by-line; its aggregate state contains counters and error-message frequencies rather than the complete input. The allocation measurement used `tracemalloc`, which adds significant runtime overhead (372.366 seconds when enabled) and therefore is reported separately from the production runtime.
